title: Page 1
summary: A declassified-style intelligence summary on Bin Laden's intent to strike the US. From 1997-1998, Bin Laden reportedly wanted attacks in the US, with followers citing US TV interviews and a planned retaliation after US missile strikes in Afghanistan. Covered: the Millennium plot in Canada (Ressam, linked to lieutenant Abu Zubaydah), the 1998 Kenya and Tanzania embassy bombings showing long-term planning, al-Qa'ida surveillance of US embassies, and reported hijacking talk and recruitment of Muslim-American youth. Some claims are uncorroborated.

title: Page 2
summary: A fragmentary August 6, 2001 intelligence-style note (marked 'For the President Only') reports suspicious FBI activity, including hijackings of federal buildings and patterns of information consistent with attack preparations, with recent surveillance of types of sites in New York. It notes the FBI is conducting about 70 full field investigations across the US tied to Bin Laden-related matters, and that CIA and UAE sources said Bin Laden supporters were planning attacks in the US, possibly involving explosives.
